Country and location: New Caledonia, Loyalty Islands offshore, 124 km northeast of Wé
Spain, Murcia, 4 km northeast of Lorca
Notes: The 2011 Lorca earthquake caused significant localized damage and panic among locals, leaving many displaced from their homes. Nine people were killed and 403 others were injured.

Country and location: Turkey, Kütahya, 12 km north northeast of Simav
Notes: After the 2011 Kütahya earthquake, many locals panicked and power was lost to most of Simav, and some buildings sustained damage. An elderly woman in İnegöl suffered a heart-attack and died in the immediate aftermath of the tremor, while in Simav, one person was killed after being struck by a concrete block. 122 others were injured.
